content.short: Security Research Labs has provided blockchain security assurance worldwide since 2019 with a 15-person team.
content.description: Security Research Labs has delivered blockchain security assurance worldwide since 2019, backed by a 15-person team. The firm serves as the primary auditor for Parity/Polkadot and for numerous parachains, including Moonbeam. Its engineers also extend their auditing and review capabilities to other Layer 0 ecosystems, such as Autonomys, Tanssi, and Cosmos, helping projects identify and remediate critical vulnerabilities early in development and deployment.
